name: Get segment count
description: Call this when you need to know how many contacts match a given segment query without retrieving the contacts themselves. If you need the actual contact records, use the contacts listing action instead.

fe_query.description: The front‑end query object defining the segment filter criteria.

searchBy.description: A free‑text search term applied to the segment query.

contact_count.description: Number of contacts that match the provided query.

total_count.description: Total number of contacts in the system (or in the scope of the query).
